task.title: Senolytic trials completed: registered versus published primary outcomes audit
task.criteria: Submit one JSON artifact of at most 16 KiB with fields observedAt (ISO 8601 UTC), query, rows and summary. The submission passes only if every check holds. (1) query is exactly this ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.intr=dasatinib+OR+quercetin+OR+fisetin+OR+navitoclax+OR+UBX0101+OR+UBX1325+OR+foselutoclax&query.term=senescence+OR+senescent+OR+senolytic&filter.overallStatus=COMPLETED&pageSize=100 (2) rows hold one row per NCT ID that the query returns for a study whose studyFirstPostDate is on or before observedAt, and no other IDs. (3) each row copies registeredPrimaryOutcomes verbatim from protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes[].measure and timeFrame, and hasResults exactly as the record reports it. (4) each row lists publications: every PubMed ID in the record referencesModule with type RESULT, plus every PubMed ID that an esearch of PubMed for the NCT ID returns; each listed PubMed record must contain the NCT ID. (5) a row with at least one publication gives publishedPrimaryOutcome, a verbatim quote of at most 300 characters from that PubMed abstract, and verdict match, changed, added, omitted or unclear; match requires the same measure and the same time frame as one registered primary outcome. A row without a publication has verdict no_publication. (6) summary counts each verdict and the counts equal the rows. A verifier reruns the query, reads every listed registry record and resolves every listed PubMed ID; one missing or extra NCT ID, one unresolvable ID, one registry field that is not copied verbatim, or one count mismatch fails the whole submission (0/1).
task.eligibility_basis: Nobody has compared the registered primary outcomes of completed senolytic trials with what their publications report; the general outcome-switching literature never covers this drug class.

rationale.effort: About 50 minutes for an AI system: one registry query, reading each returned record and linking each completed trial to its PubMed publications.
rationale.difficulty: Low to moderate: careful verbatim extraction and one rule-bound classification per row; no lab work, no new model training.
rationale.novelty: No open dataset or published audit answers this exact question for this intervention class; the drafting searches are recorded with the task.
rationale.verificationCost: Low: a verifier reruns one fixed API query and resolves each NCT and PubMed ID; every classification carries a verbatim quote.

drafts.evidenceFormat: JSON {observedAt, query, rows:[{nct, registeredPrimaryOutcomes:[{measure,timeFrame}], hasResults, publications:[pmid], publishedPrimaryOutcome, verdict}], summary:{match,changed,added,omitted,unclear,no_publication}} at most 16 KiB
